build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p skillhub-cli && node scripts/stage-cli.mjs --debug && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release -p skillhub-cli && node scripts/stage-cli.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://fonts.googleapis.com https://fonts.gstatic.com
